results.question: What does error KST-2044 mean and how do I fix it?
results.expected_answer: The data source refused the connection because the Kestrel IP addresses are not on its allowlist. Add both 203.0.113.10 and 203.0.113.11; adding only one causes intermittent errors.

results.question: A user gets KST-4012 when accepting an invitation. What should support tell them?
results.expected_answer: There is no free seat. An Admin must free a seat, or the Owner must add seats or upgrade. The same invitation then works if it is less than 7 days old.

results.question: What happens, step by step, when a customer's card payment fails?
results.expected_answer: E-mail to the Owner and billing contact, retries after 1, 3 and 7 days, then a 21-day grace period (everything works), then read-only, then suspension at 60 days. Nothing is deleted.

results.question: Which plans include single sign-on, and how does an admin set it up?
results.expected_answer: Business and Enterprise. An Admin opens Settings → Security → Single sign-on, downloads the Kestrel SP metadata, registers Kestrel in the identity provider, pastes the IdP metadata URL back, tests with one Admin, then enforces it.

results.question: I lost my phone and I can't log in anymore. What can I do?
results.expected_answer: Use a backup code. Without one, ask a workspace Admin to reset your second factor. If you are the only Admin or the Owner, contact support from the account's e-mail address; identity verification can take up to 2 business days.

results.question: Can I get a refund on my annual plan 45 days after it renewed?
results.expected_answer: Yes, under the current (March 2026) policy: annual plans are refundable within 60 days of renewal, pro-rated from the request date. The old 2025 policy allowed only 30 days.

results.question: How much do I save by paying annually instead of monthly?
results.expected_answer: 20% compared with twelve months of monthly billing (it was 15% under the 2025 policy).

results.question: Error KST-5031 happened on the last two scheduled reports. Which team should support contact, and where?
results.expected_answer: Messaging, which owns postroom: post in #oncall-messaging as SEV-2. Outside 08:00–20:00 on weekdays, escalate to the Platform on-call.

results.question: Is there a Kestrel mobile app for iPhone?
How much does one seat cost per month on the Business plan?
results.expected_answer: Not in the documents (the billing policy says prices are on the pricing page).

results.question: Many dashboards of one customer suddenly stop with KST-3012, even ones that used to be fast. Who should support escalate to, and in which channel?
results.expected_answer: Analytics Engine, in #oncall-analytics. They are on a 24/7 rotation.

results.question: The automatic payment retries did not run for a customer. Which team should support contact, and in which channel?
results.expected_answer: Payments Core, they own ledger which runs the retries. Post in #oncall-payments (24/7 rotation).
